heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾貝特·凱塞林1885年11月30日生於下弗蘭肯的馬克特施泰夫特，父親卡爾曾任拜羅伊特的市學務官。他從巴伐利亞步兵砲兵起家，1906年任少尉；一戰期間先在巴伐利亞砲兵指揮官身邊任副官，1917年起以上尉身分在師與軍司令部任參謀軍官。戰後他負責巴伐利亞第3軍的復員並轉入國防軍，1922年調入國防部，在陸軍統帥部參謀部任職，1933年10月1日開始新的職涯階段。
body.en: Albert Kesselring was born on 30 November 1885 in Marktsteft, Lower Franconia; his father Karl was municipal school councillor in Bayreuth. He began with the Bavarian foot artillery (lieutenant in 1906), served in the First World War first as adjutant to Bavarian artillery commanders and from 1917 as a captain and general-staff officer in division and corps staffs. After the armistice he demobilised the Bavarian III Corps and joined the Reichswehr; in 1922 he moved to the Reichswehr ministry, on the staff of the army command, and on 1 October 1933 began a new phase of his career.

citations.quote: * 30.11.1885 Marktsteft (Unterfranken)
Lehrer, dann Stadtschulrat in Bayreuth;
bei der bayerischen Fußartillerie (1906 Leutnant)
zunächst in Adjutantenstellungen bei bayerischen Artillerie-Kommandeuren
seit 1917 als Hauptmann und Generalstabsoffizier
oblag K. die Demobilisierung des bayerischen III. AK in Nürnberg
ließ er sich in die Reichswehr übernehmen
wurde er 1922 in das Reichswehrministerium versetzt
im Stabe des Chefs der Heeresleitung
am 1.10.1933 in einen neuen Abschnitt seiner Laufbahn ein.

heading.zh-Hant: 轉入空軍與空軍參謀長
heading.en: Move to the Luftwaffe and chief of its general staff

body.zh-Hant: 1933年12月凱塞林由陸軍轉入空軍，以民事官銜「准將（Commodore）」出任帝國航空部D局（後稱空軍行政局）局長，並在48歲時補考飛行員資格，對這支新軍種的快速擴張有重要作用。1936年6月5日他出任空軍參謀長，1938年10月1日又出任第1航空艦隊（柏林）司令。
body.en: In December 1933 Kesselring moved from the army to the Luftwaffe with the civil title "Commodore" as head of Office D (later the Luftwaffe administration office) in the Reich Air Ministry, and at 48 he earned his pilot's licence, playing a major part in the new service's rapid growth. On 5 June 1936 he became chief of the Luftwaffe general staff, and on 1 October 1938 chief of Air Fleet 1 (Berlin).

citations.quote: Dezember: Kesselring wird vom Heer in die Luftwaffe versetzt.
mit der zivilen Dienstbezeichnung „Commodore“
zum Chef des Amtes D (später: Luftwaffenverwaltungsamt)
holte im Alter von 48 Jahren die Flugzeugführerprüfung nach
maßgebenden Anteil am rasanten Wachstum der neuen Teilstreitkraft
5.6.1936 Chef des Generalstabes der Luftwaffe
1.10.1938 Chef der Luftflotte 1 [Berlin]

heading.zh-Hant: 波蘭、西線、不列顛空戰與入侵蘇聯
heading.en: Poland, the West, the Battle of Britain and the invasion of the USSR

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月入侵波蘭時，凱塞林以第1航空艦隊司令身分參戰；1940年1月13日起改任第2航空艦隊司令，參與波蘭與西線戰役，並在1940年7月19日晉升元帥。其後他參與「海獅行動」的準備與不列顛空戰，卻也顯示德國空軍的極限。1941年6月他的航空艦隊調往波蘭，用於對蘇聯的戰事。
body.en: In September 1939 Kesselring took part in the invasion of Poland as chief of Air Fleet 1. From 13 January 1940 he was chief of Air Fleet 2, took part in the campaigns against Poland and in the West, and was made Generalfeldmarschall on 19 July 1940. The preparations for Operation Sea Lion and the Battle of Britain then showed the limits of the Luftwaffe. In June 1941 his air fleet was moved to Poland for the war against the Soviet Union.

citations.quote: Kesselring ist als Chef der Luftflotte 1 (Berlin) am Überfall auf Polen
seit 13.1.1940 als Chef der Luftflotte 2
an den Feldzügen gegen Polen (1939) und im Westen (1940) beteiligt
(19.7.1940 Generalfeldmarschall)
die Vorbereitung zum Unternehmen Seelöwe sowie die Luftschlacht über England
Im Juni 1941 wurde seine Luftflotte nach Polen verlegt
im Feldzug gegen die Sowjetunion eingesetzt

heading.zh-Hant: 義大利、地中海與戰爭末期
heading.en: Italy, the Mediterranean and the end of the war

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月1日凱塞林隨航空艦隊司令部前往義大利，並取得義大利最高統帥部旁「南線總司令」的名義職位，指揮在北非與地中海作戰的德國空軍，負責海上補給與壓制馬爾他。1942年12月1日他的指揮範圍擴及義大利與突尼西亞的全部空軍部隊；其後他統籌義大利境內的整體作戰。1945年3月11日至4月22日他接替倫德施泰特指揮西線，其後再任南線總司令；他在5月初促成所部降服，並於5月15日被美軍俘虜。
body.en: On 1 December 1941 Kesselring went to Italy with the air fleet staff and was given the post of Commander-in-Chief South at the Italian Comando Supremo, directing the German air units in North Africa and the Mediterranean (securing supply by sea, suppressing Malta). On 1 December 1942 his remit was extended to all Luftwaffe units in Italy and Tunisia, and he later took overall direction of the operations in Italy. From 11 March to 22 April 1945 he led the Western Front as Rundstedt's successor, was then again named Commander-in-Chief South, brought about the surrender of his army groups in early May, and was taken prisoner by the Americans on 15 May 1945.

citations.quote: Am 1.12.1941 ging K. mit dem Luftflottenstab
die Stellung eines Oberbefehlshabers (OB) Süd beim italienischen Comando Supremo
Nachschubsicherung auf See, Niederhaltung Maltas
auf alle Luftwaffenverbände in Italien und Tunesien erweitert (1.12.1942)
die Gesamtleitung der Operationen in Italien übernahm
vom 11.3. bis 22.4.1945 als Nachfolger Rundstedts
veranlaßte er Anfang Mai die Kapitulation seiner Heeresgruppen
Am 15.5.1945 geriet K. in amerikanische Kriegsgefangenschaft.

heading.en: Trial and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1947年5月6日，英國軍事法庭在威尼斯—梅斯特雷以違反國際法槍決人質等罪名判凱塞林有罪並處死刑；兩個月後改判無期徒刑，1952年10月他獲釋。他暫任「鋼盔團」聯邦領導人並從事寫作，1960年7月16日死於巴特瑙海姆。
body.en: On 6 May 1947 a British military court at Venice-Mestre found Kesselring guilty of the unlawful shooting of hostages and sentenced him to death; two months later this was commuted to life imprisonment, and in October 1952 he was released. He briefly led the "Stahlhelm" veterans' league and devoted himself to writing; he died in Bad Nauheim on 16 July 1960.

citations.quote: wurde am 6.5.1947 von einem britischen Militärgericht in Venedig-Mestre
zum Tode verurteilt
in lebenslängliche Haft umgewandelt
im Oktober 1952 definitiv aus der Haft entlassen
betätigte er sich vorübergehend als Bundesführer des „Stahlhelm“
16. Juli: Albert Kesselring stirbt in Bad Nauheim.

people.name: Bernard Montgomery, 1st Viscount Montgomery of Alamein

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與第一次世界大戰
heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 伯納德·勞·蒙哥馬利1887年生於倫敦，就讀桑德赫斯特皇家軍事學院後，受任皇家沃里克郡團軍官。1914年第一次伊珀爾戰役初期，他被狙擊手射穿肺部，傷勢嚴重到墓穴都已備好，但後來完全康復；此後他以參謀軍官身分參與1916年的索姆河戰役與1917年的帕森達勒戰役，並對高階將領容忍高傷亡的作風深感不滿。
body.en: Bernard Law Montgomery was born in London in 1887 and, after the Royal Military College at Sandhurst, was commissioned into the Royal Warwickshire Regiment. Early in the First World War he was shot through the lung by a sniper during the First Battle of Ypres (1914), so badly that a grave was prepared, but he recovered fully; he spent the rest of the war as a staff officer in the Battles of the Somme (1916) and Passchendaele (1917), and became critical of generals who accepted heavy casualties.

heading.zh-Hant: 比利時遠征軍、敦克爾克與第八集團軍
heading.en: BEF, Dunkirk and the Eighth Army

body.zh-Hant: 1939年英國對德宣戰後，蒙哥馬利隨英國遠征軍赴法，指揮第3師；他預判戰事將成災難，事先訓練撤退戰術，這在1940年敦克爾克撤退中發揮了關鍵作用。1942年，首相邱吉爾任命他為西部沙漠第八集團軍司令。他重振軍心、補足補給，並在1942年10月的第二次阿拉曼戰役中擊敗德義軍，贏得盟軍在陸地上的第一場大勝，成為北非戰局的轉捩點。
body.en: When Britain declared war in 1939 Montgomery was sent to France with the British Expeditionary Force and commanded the 3rd Division; expecting disaster, he trained for tactical retreat, which proved vital in the 1940 evacuation of Dunkirk. In 1942 Prime Minister Churchill appointed him commander of the Eighth Army in the Western Desert; he restored its morale and supplies and delivered the Allies their first major land victory at the Second Battle of El Alamein in October 1942, the turning point of the North African campaign.

heading.zh-Hant: 西西里、諾曼第與西北歐
heading.en: Sicily, Normandy and north-west Europe

body.zh-Hant: 1943年蒙哥馬利在盟軍入侵西西里與義大利薩萊諾的行動中扮演關鍵角色。1944年6月他指揮參加諾曼第登陸的全部盟軍地面部隊，並在法萊斯口袋包圍德軍；他構想的「市場花園行動」失敗，1944年12月的突出部戰役中則表現出色。1945年3月橫渡萊茵河後，他於5月4日接受丹麥、德國北部與荷蘭德軍的投降。
body.en: In 1943 Montgomery played a crucial role in the Allied invasions of Sicily and then Salerno in Italy. In June 1944 he commanded all the ground forces in the Allied invasion of Normandy and trapped German forces in the Falaise Pocket; his Operation Market Garden plan failed, but he commanded well in the Battle of the Bulge in December 1944. After the Rhine crossings of March 1945 he accepted the surrender of all German forces in Denmark, northern Germany and the Netherlands on 4 May 1945.

heading.en: Post-war and later life

body.zh-Hant: 戰後蒙哥馬利受封阿拉曼子爵，並出任駐西德的萊茵英軍總司令；議會資料顯示他自1946年1月31日起為上議院的阿拉曼子爵。他於1958年出版的回憶錄頗具爭議，1976年3月24日去世。
body.en: After the war Montgomery was made Viscount Montgomery of Alamein and appointed commander-in-chief of the British Army of the Rhine in West Germany; Parliament's records show him as Viscount Montgomery of Alamein in the Lords from 31 January 1946. His 1958 memoir was particularly inflammatory; he died on 24 March 1976.

people.name: Charles Portal, 1st Viscount Portal of Hungerford
people.nameZh: 第一代亨格福德的波特爾子爵查爾斯·波特爾

heading.en: Lifespan and peerage

body.zh-Hant: 查爾斯·波特爾1893年5月21日生，1971年4月22日去世。據英國議會資料，他自1945年9月17日起為亨格福德的波特爾男爵，並自1946年1月28日起為亨格福德的波特爾子爵。
body.en: Charles Portal was born on 21 May 1893 and died on 22 April 1971. Parliament's records list him as Baron Portal of Hungerford from 17 September 1945 and as Viscount Portal of Hungerford from 28 January 1946.

citations.quote: Baron Portal of Hungerford September 17, 1945 - April 22, 1971
Viscount Portal of Hungerford January 28, 1946 - April 22, 1971

heading.en: Background and the Royal Flying Corps

body.zh-Hant: 查爾斯·波特爾出身伯克郡的鄉紳家庭，祖上為胡格諾派。他先後就讀溫徹斯特公學與牛津基督堂學院，1914年大戰爆發時入伍陸軍，1915年轉入皇家飛行團，到1918年前已執行九百多次出擊。
body.en: Charles Portal came from a Berkshire gentry family of Huguenot ancestry. After Winchester and Christ Church, Oxford, he joined the army at the outbreak of war in 1914 and in 1915 transferred to the Royal Flying Corps, flying more than 900 sorties before 1918.

citations.quote: Portal came from a Berkshire gentry family of Huguenot ancestry.

heading.zh-Hant: 轟炸機司令部與對德空戰
heading.en: Bomber Command and the air campaign against Germany

body.zh-Hant: 1939年波特爾晉升空軍中將；據《牛津英國史指南》，他於1940年接掌轟炸機司令部，約六個月後改任空軍參謀長。他關切能以擴編的轟炸機部隊打擊德國（對德空戰），但在英美同盟的考量下，也願意接受轟炸機司令部物資因此被分走的代價。官方戰史附錄則記載，1939年2月1日起他擔任空軍委員會的人事委員，1940年4月3日由戈薩吉接任該職。
body.en: Portal was promoted air marshal in 1939; according to the Oxford Companion to British History he took over Bomber Command in 1940 and, after six months, became Chief of the Air Staff. He was concerned to be able to strike Germany with an enlarged bomber force, yet, valuing the Anglo-American alliance, accepted a significant loss of materiel for Bomber Command. The official history lists him as Air Member for Personnel from 1 February 1939, with Gossage succeeding to that post on 3 April 1940.

citations.quote: Promoted air marshal in 1939 he took over Bomber Command in 1940
but after six months became chief of the air staff

heading.en: Chief of the Air Staff and later career

body.zh-Hant: 1940年10月25日，波特爾接替紐厄爾出任空軍參謀長，直到大戰結束。他在三軍參謀長委員會中與英美同盟的建立關係密切：他理解美國將按自己的方式參戰，並認為密切的英美關係符合英國的最佳利益。艾森豪威爾認為他是所有戰時領袖中最出色者；戰後他於1946至1951年掌管哈維爾原子能研究機構，1960至1968年任英國飛機公司董事長。
body.en: On 25 October 1940 Portal succeeded Newall as Chief of the Air Staff, a post he retained until the end of the war. He understood that America would fight on its own terms and judged that a close US-UK relationship was in Britain's best interests. Eisenhower thought him the finest of all the war leaders; after the war he served as controller of the atomic energy establishment at Harwell (1946-51) and as chairman of the British Aircraft Corporation (1960-8).

people.name: John Jellicoe, 1st Earl Jellicoe
people.nameZh: 第一代傑利科伯爵約翰·傑利科

heading.en: Lifespan and peerage

body.zh-Hant: 約翰·傑利科1859年12月5日生，1935年11月20日去世。據英國議會資料，他自1918年1月15日起為傑利科子爵，並自1925年6月29日起為傑利科伯爵（同日另獲布羅卡斯子爵頭銜）。
body.en: John Jellicoe was born on 5 December 1859 and died on 20 November 1935. Parliament's records list him as Viscount Jellicoe from 15 January 1918 and as Earl Jellicoe from 29 June 1925 (when he also became Viscount Brocas).

citations.quote: December 5, 1859 - November 20, 1935
Viscount Jellicoe January 15, 1918 - November 20, 1935
Earl Jellicoe June 29, 1925 - November 20, 1935
Viscount Brocas June 29, 1925 - November 20, 1935

heading.en: Early naval career

body.zh-Hant: 約翰·傑利科1859年12月5日生於南安普敦，出身海軍世家，13歲前便進入海軍受訓。1898年他赴東亞水域擔任西摩爵士的參謀長；1905年調海軍部主管海軍軍械。1910年以中將銜出任大西洋艦隊司令，得以指揮新式無畏艦；1912年回海軍部任第二海務大臣。
body.en: John Jellicoe was born at Southampton on 5 December 1859 into a long naval tradition and was training for the navy before the age of thirteen. In 1898 he went to East Asian waters as chief of staff to Admiral Seymour; in 1905 he was assigned to the Admiralty in charge of naval ordnance. In 1910, then a vice admiral, he was given command of the Atlantic Fleet, and in 1912 he returned to the Admiralty as Second Sea Lord.

heading.zh-Hant: 大艦隊總司令與日德蘭海戰
heading.en: Grand Fleet command and the Battle of Jutland

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月4日英國參戰之日，傑利科受命為英國大艦隊總司令。1916年5月底，德國公海艦隊向大艦隊挑戰，爆發大戰中唯一的大規模海戰——日德蘭海戰。雙方損失慘重，但德國艦隊趁勢逃回基地；傑利科在戰略上阻止了德艦再度出海，然而政府與輿論以未能徹底殲滅德國艦隊為由要求撤換他。1916年11月，他轉任海軍部第一海務大臣，在該職約一年。
body.en: On 4 August 1914, the day Britain entered the war, Jellicoe was appointed commander-in-chief of the British Grand Fleet. At the end of May 1916 the German High Seas Fleet challenged the Grand Fleet, producing the war's only great naval action, the Battle of Jutland. Both sides lost heavily, but the German fleet escaped destruction by slipping back to its bases; the source judges that Jellicoe had won a strategic victory because the German fleet never again came out to fight, yet the government and public opinion demanded his removal for failing to crush it completely. In November 1916 he was transferred to the Admiralty as First Sea Lord, a post he held for about a year.

to be commander in chief of the British Grand Fleet.
At the end of May 1916 the German High Seas Fleet challenged the Grand Fleet
the war's only great naval action, the Battle of Jutland.
but the German fleet escaped destruction by slipping back safely to its bases.
demanded his removal for failure to crush the German fleet completely
In November 1916 Jellicoe was transferred to the Admiralty as first sea lord
and remained in that post about a year.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後巡視帝國海防、紐西蘭總督與晚年
heading.en: Post-war imperial tour, New Zealand and later life

body.zh-Hant: 戰後傑利科復出，巡視帝國各地並評估其海防，隨後出任紐西蘭總督（1920至1924年）。他於1918年受封子爵，1925年晉為伯爵。經過約十年的積極退休生活，他於1935年11月20日去世。
body.en: After the war Jellicoe returned to service to tour the empire and assess its naval defences, then served as Governor-General of New Zealand (1920-1924). He was made a viscount in 1918 and an earl in 1925, and after ten years of active retirement he died on 20 November 1935.

people.name: Herbert Kitchener, 1st Earl Kitchener
people.nameZh: 第一代基奇納伯爵赫伯特·基奇納

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與皇家工兵、蘇丹埃及軍
heading.en: Origins, Royal Engineers and the Egyptian Army

body.zh-Hant: 霍雷肖·赫伯特·基奇納1850年6月24日生於愛爾蘭凱里郡，1868至1870年在伍利奇皇家軍事學院受訓。1871年他受任皇家工兵軍官；其後在塞浦路斯與巴勒斯坦等地從事測量工作，並在1884至85年的戈登救援遠征中任副官。1888年1月他在漢杜卜之役負傷，1892年出任埃及軍隊的「西達爾」（總司令）。
body.en: Horatio Herbert Kitchener was born on 24 June 1850 in County Kerry, Ireland, and trained at the Royal Military Academy, Woolwich, in 1868–70. He was commissioned into the Royal Engineers in 1871, worked on survey expeditions in Cyprus and Palestine, and served as an aide de camp on the Gordon Relief Expedition of 1884–85. He was wounded at the Battle of Handub in January 1888 and in 1892 was appointed Sirdar (commander-in-chief) of the Egyptian Army.

heading.en: Conquest of the Sudan and the Boer War

body.zh-Hant: 1898年9月2日，基奇納在恩圖曼戰役擊敗馬赫迪軍，同年9月4日攻占喀土穆；1899年12月18日他出任蘇丹總督。1899至1902年的南非戰爭中，他先任參謀長，後任總司令，其中擔任羅伯茲勛爵參謀長的任命在1900年；戰爭的燒毀農場與集中營等黑暗面，批評也多落在他身上。
body.en: On 2 September 1898 Kitchener defeated the Mahdist army at the Battle of Omdurman, and on 4 September Khartoum was taken; on 18 December 1899 he became governor-general of the Sudan. In the Boer War (1899–1902) he went first as chief of staff, later as commander-in-chief, being posted to South Africa as Lord Roberts's chief of staff in 1900; blame for the war's darker aspects, including scorched earth tactics and concentration camps, fell on him.

heading.en: Commander-in-Chief in India and Egypt

body.zh-Hant: 1902年至1909年基奇納擔任駐印度的英軍總司令，將三個管區軍隊整併為統一的印度軍，並與總督寇松起衝突、導致寇松辭職；1909年晉升元帥。1911年至1914年他在埃及與蘇丹擔任英國的高級專員（英國駐埃及代表）。
body.en: From 1902 to 1909 Kitchener was commander-in-chief of the British forces in India, merged the three Presidency armies into one Indian Army and clashed with the Viceroy, Lord Curzon, who resigned; he was promoted field marshal in 1909. From 1911 to 1914 he served as British high commissioner (British agent) in Egypt and the Sudan.

heading.en: Secretary of State for War and death

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月6日，首相阿斯奎斯任命基奇納為陸軍大臣；他預見戰爭將持續多年，號召志願兵組成「新軍」，並在同年成為伯爵。1915年的炮彈危機與達達尼爾遠征失敗後，他的影響力下降。1916年6月5日，他在前往俄國的外交任務途中，所乘「漢普郡」號巡洋艦在奧克尼群島外觸雷沉沒，基奇納罹難。
body.en: On 6 August 1914 Prime Minister Asquith appointed Kitchener Secretary of State for War; he foresaw a long war, appealed for volunteers for his "New Armies", and was made an earl that year. His influence declined after the 1915 shell crisis and the failed Dardanelles expedition. On 5 June 1916, on a mission to Russia, the cruiser Hampshire struck a mine off the Orkneys and Kitchener was killed.
